notes: Role-grant alerts now cover every directory role with three severity tiers that follow the Identity → Privileged tab: Global Administrator highest, Tier 0 high, all other roles a tier lower (permanent medium, eligible low).

Net-new only: PIM activations and re-grants to accounts that already hold or are eligible for the role are suppressed — while converting an eligibility into a permanent assignment is flagged as the escalation it is.
Severity always follows your change allowlist: a sanctioned granter logs as low for the audit trail, regardless of role.
